notes: Workbook is a single UTF-8 TSV/CSV table (sheet 商品, header row 0, 12 data rows); there are no pricing, inventory or promotion tables, so /inventory and /promotions remain empty optional collections.
商品コード is typed as int by the profiler but is displayed zero-padded (00470001–00470012); it must be cast to text without stripping zeros to satisfy the /sku identity key.
One price record per SKU is produced from 価格リスト + 税抜価格 (plus 税込 → vat_included and 税率 → vat_rate). No effective_from / effective_to columns exist, so those optional price fields stay null.
Currency 'JPY' comes from the explicit 通貨 column on every row and deliberately overrides the schema default 'THB'; no FX conversion is applied.
The 5% tax rate and 'いいえ' (tax-excluded) flag are explicit source values from this synthetic fixture; they are used as stated and are not inferred from the Japanese locale.
Unresolved: none blocking. Optional gaps only — no brand, barcode, category, description, inventory or promotion data is present in this file.

tables.reason: Single flat sheet with one row per item: a unique item code (商品コード, 12 distinct of 12 rows), a unique item name (商品名), plus price-related attributes (price list, VAT-exclusive price, VAT flags and rate) and unit/currency descriptors. Header row 0, 12 data rows, no title, no duplicates — classic product master with an embedded standard price.

columns.name: 商品コード
columns.reason: Header 商品コード = product code; 12 distinct values across 12 rows, unique ratio 1.0, barcode-like hint. Values are displayed as 8-character zero-padded codes (00470001…00470012) although typed as int, so they must be read as text and leading zeros preserved per operator requirement (identity key /sku).

columns.name: 商品名
columns.reason: Header 商品名 = product name; 12 distinct values, one per row, samples 'テスト商品 1'…'テスト商品 10'. Required target field /product_name.

columns.name: 通貨
columns.reason: Header 通貨 = currency; single distinct value 'JPY' on all 12 rows. Explicit source evidence for ISO-4217 code, so it overrides the schema default 'THB' (no FX conversion, currency stated by the file itself).

columns.name: 単位
columns.reason: Header 単位 = unit/unit of measure; single distinct value 'PCS' matching the enum_hint of /unit/sell_unit. No pack-size column exists, so /unit/pack_size stays unmapped (optional).

columns.name: 価格リスト
columns.reason: Header 価格リスト = price list; single distinct value 'standard' on all rows, matching the target default 'standard' explicitly required by the operator. Identifies the price collection entry.

columns.name: 税抜価格
columns.reason: Header 税抜価格 literally means 'price excluding tax'; integers 1234–2334, one per row, never empty. This is the price amount, but note that its VAT-exclusive semantics must be expressed through /prices/*/vat_included rather than assumed.

columns.name: 税込
columns.reason: Header 税込 ('tax included') holds the single value 'いいえ' (no) on all 12 rows, consistent with 税抜価格 being tax-exclusive. Requires a value map いいえ→false (and はい→true) into the boolean /prices/*/vat_included; the raw text is not a boolean.

columns.name: 税率
columns.reason: Header 税率 = tax rate; single distinct value '5%' on all 12 rows (typed float 5.0, percent hint). Explicit source rate converted to the fraction 0.05 for /prices/*/vat_rate — it must be taken from the file, not from any assumed country rate.

/sku now reads 商品コード as text with trim so the zero-padded codes 00470001–00470012 keep their leading zeros (draft only had a low-confidence trim fallback).
Added /currency from the explicit 通貨 column ('JPY' on every row) instead of the hard-coded THB constant used in the draft; no FX conversion is applied.
Added /unit/sell_unit from 単位 ('PCS') via unit_normalize; no pack-size column exists, so /unit/pack_size stays unmapped (optional).
Added the /prices collection (one standard price per SKU) with price_list='standard', amount from 税抜価格, vat_included=false from 税込='いいえ', vat_rate=0.05 from 税率='5%'.
No /inventory or /promotions data exists in the file, so those optional collections are not emitted.
/status is not present in the source; the contract default 'active' applies and is not fabricated as a constant.
effective_from/effective_to are absent from the source, so they are left null (optional).
Draft question about SKU identity is resolved: 商品コード is unique across all 12 rows.
Quality rules tightened: /sku not_null+unique as errors, /product_name not_null, currency pattern, price amount range.
